meta.title: The Kite That Would Not Fly

paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Leo came to the park with a big red kite. He made it himself with strong paper, long pieces of wood, and a lot of glue. On the front, he drew a green dragon, and the kite looked very attractive. "This is the best kite in the world," he said. Lily, the writer of the blog, took a photo of it for the next post. Mia and May carried a bag with water and fruit.

The Explorers found a wide area of grass in the middle of the park. Teacher Kim looked at the flags near the gate. They did not move at all. "A kite needs wind," she said. "The air is very still today." "Is the wind sleeping?" asked May with a small smile. "It will fly," said Leo, and he began to run.

The kite went up for two seconds and then fell on the grass. Leo tried again, and the kite fell again. Mia counted the seconds, and the kite stayed up for less time each try. He tried a third time with an extra line, but the kite did not even leave the ground. "Your kite is too heavy," said Mia. "It is not heavy!" said Leo. Lily lifted it, and her arms went down a little. May looked at the sky and did not say anything. Teacher Kim stood near the gate and watched the flags again.

Leo tried two more times, and both times his kite failed. Then he sat down on the grass with the kite on his knees. "I do not want to run anymore," he said. "A good explorer does not stop," said Lily. "Possibly the wind is somewhere else." She pointed at the small hill at the end of the park.

Teacher Kim smiled and took her bag. Then the Explorers walked up the hill with the kite. At the top, there was a small tree, and its leaves moved. Mia held up her hand and felt a soft wind on her fingers. "Now, Leo," said May. Leo stood up, and Lily held the red kite high above her head. "One, two, three!" said Mia. Lily opened her hands, and the green dragon began to climb. Leo ran down the hill with the line in both hands, and everybody shouted.
text.summary: Leo makes a big red kite for a wind day in the park, but the air is still and the kite will not fly. The Explorers climb a hill where the wind is stronger.
